about_the_game:
Brand new recording for the remake of Trials of Mana!

This soundtrack features in-game music from Trials of Mana released on April 24, 2020.

The original compositions by Hiroki Kikuta have been entirely rearranged to match this remake.

Renowned arrangers Ryo Yamazaki, Tsuyoshi Sekito, Koji Yamaoka, and Sachiko Miyano joined forces to breathe new life into iconic tracks.

Beloved tracks such as the mysterious opening sequence "Where Angels Fear to Tread" and the heroic prologue melody "Meridian Child" will be brought to life with a full orchestra, reimagined through newly remade sound.
